title: Cross-Border Fulfillment Center Selection via Doubly Robust Estimation and Linear Programming
abstract: arXiv:2611.14174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce the cross-border (XB) fulfillment center (FC) Selection Model: a multi-stage optimization framework combining forecasting, doubly robust estimation, and linear programming to select optimal source FCs. For each source-destination shipping arc, the objective is to choose a subset of source-country FCs that minimize delivery time and cost while maximizing profit and shipped units under a fixed domestic network. We evaluate the model on three production-scale international shipping corridors for a large e-commerce company using 12 months of shipment data, employing both aggregate offline replay and shipment-level counterfactual nearest-neighbor matching. translated_title: 基于双重稳健估计与线性规划的跨境履约中心选择
translated_abstract: 我们提出了跨境履约中心选择模型：这是一个多阶段优化框架，结合了预测、双重稳健估计和线性规划，用于选择最优的源履约中心。对于每条源-目的地运输线路，目标是在固定国内网络的条件下，选择一个源国家履约中心子集，以最小化配送时间和成本，同时最大化利润和发货量。我们利用某大型电商公司12个月的运输数据，在三条生产规模的国际运输走廊上对该模型进行评估，采用聚合离线回放和运输级反事实最近邻匹配两种方法。在所有运输走廊上，与人工专家定义的履约中心选择策略相比，跨境履约中心选择模型实现了8.5%-51.1%的配送时间降低和4.4%-48.3%的物流成本降低，在5/5目标合规性上最多提升了6.5个百分点（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个融合预测、双重稳健估计与线性规划的多阶段优化框架来选择最优跨境履约中心，在三条生产级国际运输走廊上相比人工专家策略实现了8.5%-51.1%的配送时间降低和4.4%-48.3%的物流成本降低。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a multi-stage optimization framework combining forecasting, doubly robust estimation, and linear programming for cross-border fulfillment center selection, achieving 8.5-51.1% delivery time reductions and 4.4-48.3% logistics cost reductions over human expert policies across three production-scale international shipping corridors.
